raw_problem.solution_text:
由题意可知，取试探波函数为

$$
\psi (r, \theta , \phi) = A \mathrm {e} ^ {- b r ^ {2}} Y _ {1} ^ {0} (\theta , \phi) = \sqrt {\frac {3}{4 \pi}} A \mathrm {e} ^ {- b r ^ {2}} \cos \theta .
$$

先对波函数进行归一化求系数 $A$

$$
\begin{array}{l} 1 = \langle \psi | \psi \rangle = | A | ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r \int \left| Y _ {1} ^ {0} \right| ^ {2} \mathrm {d} \Omega = | A | ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \left(- \frac {r}{4 b}\right) \mathrm {d} \left(- 2 b r ^ {2}\right) \\ = | A | ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \left(- \frac {r}{4 b}\right) \mathrm {d e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} = | A | ^ {2} \left[ - \frac {r}{4 b} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \left(- \frac {1}{4 b}\right) \mathrm {d} r \right] \\ = | A | ^ {2} \left[ 0 + \frac {1}{4 b} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}}}{\sqrt {2 b}} \mathrm {d} (\sqrt {2 b r}) \right] = \frac {| A | ^ {2}}{4 b \sqrt {2 b}} \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2} = \frac {| A | ^ {2}}{8 b} \sqrt {\frac {\pi}{2 b}}, \\ \end{array}
$$

故

$$
A = 2 \left(\frac {8 b ^ {3}}{\pi}\right) ^ {\frac {1}{4}}.
$$

势能期望值为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle V \rangle = \langle \psi | \frac {- e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} r} | \psi \rangle = \frac {- e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} | A | ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \frac {1}{r} r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left(4 \sqrt {\frac {8 b ^ {3}}{\pi}}\right) \frac {1}{4 b} \\ = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \sqrt {\frac {8 b}{\pi}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

对于动能期望值，先求函数的工阶微分，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \nabla^ {2} \psi = \left[ \frac {1}{r ^ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial r} \left(r ^ {2} \frac {\partial}{\partial r}\right) + \frac {1}{r ^ {2} \sin \theta} \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta}\right) \right] \psi \\ = \sqrt {\frac {3}{4 \pi}} A \left\{\frac {\cos \theta}{r ^ {2}} \frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} r} \left[ r ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- b r ^ {2}} (- 2 b r) \right] + \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- b r ^ {2}}}{r ^ {2} \sin \theta} \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} (- \sin^ {2} \theta) \right\} \\ = \sqrt {\frac {3}{4 \pi}} A \left[ \frac {- 2 b \cos \theta}{r ^ {2}} \left(- 2 b r ^ {4} e ^ {- b r ^ {2}} + 3 r ^ {2} e ^ {- b r ^ {2}}\right) - \frac {e ^ {- b r ^ {2}}}{r ^ {2} \sin \theta} (2 \sin \theta \cos \theta) \right] \\ = \sqrt {\frac {3}{\pi}} A \mathrm {e} ^ {- b r ^ {2}} \frac {\cos \theta}{r ^ {2}} \left(2 b ^ {2} r ^ {4} - 3 b r ^ {2} - 1\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle T \rangle = \langle \psi | - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla^ {2} | \psi \rangle = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \langle \psi | \nabla^ {2} | \psi \rangle \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \int \left(\sqrt {\frac {3}{4 \pi}} A \mathrm {e} ^ {- b r ^ {2}} \cos \theta\right) \left[ \sqrt {\frac {3}{\pi}} A \mathrm {e} ^ {- b r ^ {2}} \frac {\cos \theta}{r ^ {2}} \left(2 b ^ {2} r ^ {4} - 3 b r ^ {2} - 1\right) \right] \mathrm {d} \tau \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \sqrt {\frac {3}{4 \pi}} \sqrt {\frac {3}{\pi}} | A | ^ {2} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \cos^ {2} \theta (2 b ^ {2} r ^ {4} - 3 b r ^ {2} - 1) \sin \theta \mathrm {d} r \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {3 \hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{4 m \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \left(2 b ^ {2} r ^ {4} - 3 b r ^ {2} - 1\right) \mathrm {d} r \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos^ {2} \theta \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {3 \hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\int_ {0} ^ {\infty} 2 b ^ {2} r ^ {4} e ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} d r - \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} 3 b r ^ {2} e ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} d r \right. \\ \left. - \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} r\right) \left[ - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos^ {2} \theta \mathrm {d} (\cos \theta) \right] \\ = - \frac {3 \hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{2 m} \left[ 2 b ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r ^ {4} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} r - 3 b \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} r \right. \\ \left. - \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}}}{\sqrt {2 b}} \mathrm {d} (\sqrt {2 b r}) \right] \left(\frac {- \cos^ {2} \theta}{3}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\pi} \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{m} \left[ 2 b ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {r ^ {3} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}}}{- 4 b} \mathrm {d} (- 2 b r ^ {2}) - 3 b \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {r \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}}}{- 4 b} \mathrm {d} (- 2 b r ^ {2}) - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 b}} \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2} \right] \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{m} \left(- \frac {b}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r ^ {3} \mathrm {d e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} + \frac {3}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} r \mathrm {d e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} - \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2 \sqrt {2 b}}\right) \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{m} \left(\frac {b}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} 3 r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r - \frac {3}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} r - \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2 \sqrt {2 b}}\right) \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{m} \left[ \frac {b}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \left(- \frac {3 r}{4 b}\right) \mathrm {d} \left(- 2 b r ^ {2}\right) \right. \\ \left. - \frac {3}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 b}} \mathrm {d} \left(\sqrt {2 b} r\right) - \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2 \sqrt {2 b}} \right] \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{m} \left[ - \frac {3}{8} \int r \mathrm {d e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} - \frac {3}{4 \sqrt {2 b}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} \left(\sqrt {2 b} r\right) - \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2 \sqrt {2 b}} \right] \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{m} \left(\frac {3}{8} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} r - \frac {3}{4 \sqrt {2 b}} \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2} - \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{2 \sqrt {2 b}}\right) \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{m} \left[ \frac {3}{8} \int \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b r ^ {2}}}{\sqrt {2 b}} \mathrm {d} \left(\sqrt {2 b r}\right) - \frac {7 \sqrt {\pi}}{8 \sqrt {2 b}} \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2} | A | ^ {2}}{m} \sqrt {\frac {\pi}{2 b}} \frac {1 1}{1 6}. \\ \end{array}
$$

将 $A = 2 \left( \frac { 8 b ^ { 3 } } { \pi } \right) ^ { \frac { 1 } { 4 } }$ 代入上式,得

$$
\langle T \rangle = \frac {1 1 b \hbar^ {2}}{2 m}.
$$

$$
\langle H \rangle = \langle T \rangle + \langle V \rangle = \frac {1 1 b \hbar^ {2}}{2 m} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \sqrt {\frac {8 b}{\pi}}.
$$

为求极小值，对 $\langle H \rangle$ 进行微分，得

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \left<   H \right > }{\mathrm {d} b} = \frac {1 1 \hbar^ {2}}{2 m} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi b}} = 0.
$$

$b = \left( { \frac { e ^ { 2 } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } } } { \sqrt { \frac { 2 } { \pi } } } { \frac { 2 m } { 1 1 \hbar ^ { 2 } } } \right) ^ { 2 }$ 2 如 再代毗 $\langle H \rangle$ 中,得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left<   H \right> _ {\mathrm {m i n}} = \frac {1 1 \hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \frac {2 m}{1 1 \hbar^ {2}}\right) ^ {2} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \sqrt {\frac {8}{\pi}} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \frac {2 m}{1 1 \hbar^ {2}}\right) \\ = - \frac {4}{1 1 \pi} \frac {m e ^ {4}}{\hbar^ {2} (4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}) ^ {2}} = \frac {3 2}{1 1 \pi} \frac {- m e ^ {4}}{8 \hbar^ {2} (4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}) ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {3 2}{1 1 \pi} E _ {2} = 0. 9 2 6 E _ {2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

此值为第一激发态能量的上限

串串习题 8.21 如果光子的质量不等于军 $( m _ { \gamma } \neq 0 )$ ，则库仑势可由汤川势代替，

$$
V (\boldsymbol {r}) = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \mu r}}{r},
$$

其中 $\mu = m _ { \gamma } c / \hbar$ . 用你选用的试探泼函数，估算在这种作用势下"氢"原子的结合能.假设 $\mu a \ll 1$ ，给出你的结果，精确至 $\left( \mu a \right) ^ { 2 }$ 数量级.

解答汤川势是日本物理学家汤川秀树在他的介子理论中提出的，用以描述粒子之间短程相互作用.在粒子物理中，汤川势具有如 形式:

$$
V _ {\mathrm {Y u k a w a}} (r) = - g ^ {2} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {\kappa m r}}{r},
$$

其中 $g$ 是粒子相互作用藕合常数， $m$ 是相互作用粒子的质量 $r$ 是粒子之间的距商， $\kappa$ 是另外一个常数，$1 / ( \kappa m )$ 表示核力作用范围.在电磁学中，库仑势是汤川势在 $\mathrm { e } ^ { \kappa m r } = 1$ 的特殊情况，说明了光子的静止质量为零，这也表明电磁相互作用是通过交换光子产生的.

氢原子的基态波函数为 $\psi _ { 1 0 0 } = { \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { \pi a ^ { 3 } } } } \mathrm { e } ^ { - { \frac { r } { a } } } , a$ 为玻尔半径，本题中将原有的库仑势变为汤川势，我们可以选取 $a  b$ 为变分参数，则试探波函数为 $\psi _ { 1 0 0 } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { \pi b ^ { 3 } } } \mathrm { e } ^ { - \frac { r } { b } }$ 苦，动能项类比于方程 (4.218)，得$\langle T \rangle = - E _ { 1 } = \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 2 m b ^ { 2 } }$ 能项为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle V \rangle = \langle \psi | - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- u r}}{r} | \psi \rangle = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \int \frac {1}{\pi b ^ {3}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {2 r}{b}} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- u r}}{r} \mathrm {d} \tau \\ = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{b ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {\mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {2 r}{b}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- u r}}{r} r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = - \frac {2 \pi e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{b ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {2}{b} + u\right) r} r \mathrm {d} r [ - \cos \theta ] | _ {0} ^ {\pi} \\ = - \frac {2 e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} b ^ {3}} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {r}{- \left(\frac {2}{b} + u\right)} \mathrm {d e} ^ {- \left(\frac {2}{b} + u\right) r} \\ = \frac {e ^ {2}}{\pi \varepsilon_ {0} b ^ {3}} \frac {b}{2 + b u} \left[ r \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {2}{b} + u\right) r} \Big | _ {0} ^ {\infty} - \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {2}{b} + u\right) r} \mathrm {d} r \right] \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = \frac {b e ^ {2}}{\pi \varepsilon_ {0} b ^ {3}} \frac {1}{2 + b u} \left\{\frac {1}{\frac {2}{b} + u} \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {2}{b} + u\right) r} \mathrm {d} \left[ - \left(\frac {2}{b} + u\right) r \right] \right\} \\ = \left. \frac {b e ^ {2}}{\pi \varepsilon_ {0} b ^ {3}} \frac {1}{2 + b u} \frac {b}{2 + b u} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(\frac {2}{b} + u\right) r} \right| _ {0} ^ {\infty} \\ = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} b} \frac {1}{\left(1 + \frac {u b}{2}\right) ^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

哈密顿量平均值为

$$
\langle H \rangle = \langle T \rangle + \langle V \rangle = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m b ^ {2}} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} b} \frac {1}{\left(1 + \frac {u b}{2}\right) ^ {2}}.
$$

求极值，对 $\langle H \rangle$ 作微分，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial \left\langle H \right\rangle}{\partial b} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} (- 2) \frac {1}{b ^ {3}} - \left[ \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} (- 1) \frac {1}{b ^ {2}} \frac {1}{\left(1 + \frac {u b}{2}\right) ^ {2}} + \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} b} (- 2) \frac {1}{\left(1 + \frac {u b}{2}\right) ^ {3}} \frac {u}{2} \right] \\ = \frac {- \hbar^ {2}}{m b ^ {3}} + \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1 + \frac {3 u b}{2}}{b ^ {2} \left(1 + \frac {u b}{2}\right) ^ {3}} = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

即

$$
\frac {\hbar^ {2}}{m} \frac {4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}}{e ^ {2}} = b \frac {1 + \frac {3 u b}{2}}{\left(1 + \frac {u b}{2}\right) ^ {3}} \Rightarrow a = \frac {1 + \frac {3 u b}{2}}{\left(1 + \frac {u b}{2}\right) ^ {3}}.
$$

这里要求出变分参数 $b$ 但是上式中为 $b ^ { 3 }$ 项，不便于求 $b$ 的精确表达式.考虑到 $u = 0$ 时， $b = a$ 也就是光子质量为零.因此，我们可以合理地认为 $u a \ll 1$ 和 $u b \ll 1$ 1.这样，我们将上式分母进行泰勒展开(以 ub 为小量)，得

$$
a \approx b \left(1 + \frac {3 u b}{2}\right) \left[ 1 - \frac {3 u b}{2} + 6 \left(\frac {u b}{2}\right) ^ {2} \right] = b \left[ 1 - \frac {3}{4} (u b) ^ {2} \right].
$$

由于( $( u b ) ^ { 2 }$ l己经是一个二阶小量，可以认为 $\left( u b \right) ^ { 2 } = \left( u a \right) ^ { 2 }$ .

因此可得

$$
b \approx \frac {a}{1 - \frac {3}{4} (u b) ^ {2}} \approx \frac {a}{\mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {3}{4} (u b) ^ {2}}} = a \mathrm {e} ^ {\frac {3}{4} (u b) ^ {2}} = a \left[ 1 + \frac {3}{4} (u a) ^ {2} \right].
$$

将 $b$ 代入 $\langle H \rangle$ 中，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle H \rangle_ {\min } = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m a ^ {2} \left[ 1 + \frac {3}{4} (u a) ^ {2} \right] ^ {2}} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{a \left[ 1 + \frac {3}{4} (u a) ^ {2} \right] \left[ 1 + \frac {1}{2} (u a) \right] ^ {2}} \\ \approx \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m a ^ {2}} \left[ 1 - 2 \frac {3}{4} (u a) ^ {2} \right] - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{a} \left[ 1 - \frac {3}{4} (u a) ^ {2} \right] \left[ 1 - 2 \frac {u a}{2} + 3 \left(\frac {u a}{2}\right) ^ {2} \right] \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
= E _ {1} \left[ 1 - 2 u a + \frac {3}{2} (u a) ^ {2} \right],
$$

其中 $E _ { 1 } = - \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 2 m a ^ { 2 } }$
